units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 39b:6">B. Kam. 39ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>בְּתַמּוּתוֹ</he>, <cite ref="Bava Kamma 39b:6">ib.</cite>) <he>הרי הוא בתְמִימוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> the animal remains (to its owner) in its completeness, we do not diminish it (by hypothecating it for the half-fine for damage done).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:5">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 18:26">Ps. XVIII, 26</cite>) <he>בשעה שבא בת׳ בא עמו בת׳</he> when he (Abraham, Moses) came with frankness, the Lord dealt with him in frankness, opp. <cite ref="P01205"><he>עַקְמָנוּת</he></cite>; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161:4">Yalk. Sam. 161</cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:2-3">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>מה … בת׳ … אף כל מי שמהלך לפניו בת׳ וכ׳</he> as the Lord was a shield to Araham who walked before him in sincerity, so he is a shield to whosoever walks before him in sincerity; a. e.
